commands.name: search-gems
commands.summary: Search gems by keyword (name/description); 30 results per page

commands.name: autocomplete-gem-names
commands.summary: Suggest gem names that start with or match a partial query (returns up to 30 names)

commands.name: get-gem
commands.summary: Get metadata for a gem's latest version: downloads, description, licenses, links, runtime/development dependencies

commands.name: list-gem-versions
commands.summary: List every published version of a gem, newest first, with dates, download counts and Ruby requirements

commands.name: get-latest-version
commands.summary: Get only the latest version number of a gem

commands.name: get-gem-version
commands.summary: Get full details of one specific gem version: dependencies, checksums, required Ruby, downloads

commands.name: get-version-downloads
commands.summary: Get total gem downloads and downloads of one specific version

commands.name: list-reverse-dependencies
commands.summary: List the names of all gems whose versions depend on the given gem (full list, names only)

commands.name: search-reverse-dependencies
commands.summary: Browse or filter gems whose latest version requires the given gem, with their version, date and downloads

commands.name: list-gem-owners
commands.summary: List the owners (user handles and roles) of a gem

commands.name: list-owner-gems
commands.summary: List all gems owned by a RubyGems user handle

commands.name: get-profile
commands.summary: Get a RubyGems user's public profile (id and handle)

commands.name: list-latest-gems
commands.summary: List the most recently added gems (brand-new gem names)

commands.name: list-just-updated-gems
commands.summary: List gems that just had a new version pushed

commands.name: list-new-releases
commands.summary: List recent releases across all gems (10 per page)

commands.name: list-popular-releases
commands.summary: List recent releases of popular gems, ranked by total downloads (10 per page)

commands.name: list-most-downloaded
commands.summary: List the all-time most downloaded gems with download counts (10 per page)
